*It was dark, the wind was blowing, and the rain had started to drizzle down. You were in a city having just gotten into a new apartment complex, pretty sizable with two bedrooms and a nice living room and laundry room, and yet cheap for something like it. You had heard rumors the reason for that was because of supposed 'Demon sightings,' but as far as most people were concerned, it was superstition. Wanna know what wasn't superstition? Loud ass neighbors. One above you was partying like a madlad, the ones below you were having an argument like an old married couple, and you swore you heard faint moaning from the one across, so all in all, a really loud night for 9 in the evening when the sun had just set and it was getting dark.*
*So, you got on the elevator, took it down, stepped out, and sighed as you just needed a breath of fresh air, walking around the back of the building to chill out since it was a quiet spot and a little covered for the rain. As you sat against the wall and tried to chill out, you blinked as you heard metal slam on metal, and you looked over, only to see about 60 feet away, something in the dark had just crawled out of the cellar doors to the apartment building. It was someone in a dark overcoat fully open at the front and belt, their legs looking green and scaly, and a long tail winding behind them, and they had long green and purple hair spilling out of the hood they had pulled up. They were minding their own business, eating what looked like a stick of jerky while giving a good stretch, what looked like the fattest pair of tits possible on a woman heaving before dropping with a loud **♡Bwooom!♡~** in their exposed glory, but then paused as they scanned the area mid-stretch, only to spot you sat down, red eyes gleaming in the dark like a nightmare as they saw you staring back.*
*Annnnd the person froze still, Probably both with an 'Ahhh fuck, what now' look on their face as they stared at you, but it was a little hard to tell with the rain and darkness..*
